errata.reason: The forecast-ledger probabilities were recorded as decimal fractions (0.60, 0.55, 0.45, 0.60, 0.70, 0.80) instead of the 0-100 scale DECISION_LEDGER §6 requires. Read verbatim, a 60% belief becomes 0.6% in a Brier score — silently corrupting the first calibration. scale_fix restores the 0-100 scale on read (×100); the frozen record is unchanged. This run predates eval check T2's date gate (2026-06-22), so the record itself was never re-validated.
errata.evidence: analyses/BG_2026-06-01/decision_record.json forecast_ledger[].probability all in (0,1]; DECISION_LEDGER.md §6 ('a decimal-fraction value ... is a defect')
